dataRoles.name: priorPeriod
dataRoles.description: Prior period value for variance calculation (optional).

dataRoles.name: image
dataRoles.description: A column holding a Base64 data URI (data:image/*;base64,...). Shown in the top-right of each card. External URLs are rejected: the visual makes no network requests.
Dimension to split into multiple KPI cards (optional, Pro).
dataRoles.name: smallMultiples
trend
dataRoles.description: A date or ordered field. Draws a trend line inside each card, over this axis.

dataRoles.name: secondaryKpis
dataRoles.description: Up to 3 supporting measures, shown stacked beside the main value.

dataRoles.name: secondaryPrior
dataRoles.description: Prior-period value for each Secondary KPI, matched by position: the first here pairs with the first Secondary KPI.

status.description: Colours the card by rules on the value, the target achieved or the prior period: on track, warning or off track.

period.description: What the big number shows when a field is bound to Trend.

windowSize.description: Only for "Last N points". 12 on a monthly series gives the last 12 months against the 12 before them.

compareOffset.description: 1 = the previous point. On a monthly series, 12 gives the same month last year. It is a position in the series, not a calendar step: with a gap in the data, 12 back is not 12 months back.

showPeriodLabel.description: Prints which point the value is, and which one it is compared against.

position.description: Right of the value, below it, or Auto: right, moving below when a trend line needs the width.

minWidth.description: Below this card width the secondary KPIs move below the value (Auto) or are hidden (Right). Applies to every card in small multiples, and to a single card with a trend line.

showVariance.description: Needs a measure in Secondary KPIs prior, matched by position.
